chapter_title_en: Counsel Concerning the Marriage of Nestan-Darejan
chapter_expert_explanation_en: King Parsadan and the Queen summon Tariel to a royal council and announce their decision to bring the son of the Shah of Khwarazm to marry Nestan-Darejan and rule India. Bound by feudal etiquette and fear of exposing his secret love, Tariel is forced to give outward consent while his heart breaks.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
დილასა ადრე სრას მიხმეს, დღე რა ქმნა მწუხრმან ჟამითა
ავდეგ, ვცან მათი ამბავი, წასლვა ვქმენ მითვე წამითა;
ვნახე, ორნივე ერთგან სხდეს ხასითა ოდენ სამითა,
და რა მივე, მითხრეს დაჯდომა, წინაშე დავჯე სკამითა.
stanzas.english_translation: "Early in the morning they summoned me to the palace, when day was yet at the dawn. I rose; I learned their tidings and went at the same moment. I saw them both sitting with pleased faces. When I entered they bade me be seated; I sat down before them on a chair.

stanzas.english_translation: "They said to me: 'God has brought old age upon us so that we are exhausted, the time of age approaches us, youth has passed from us. We have no son, but we have a daughter whose rays fail us not; we care not for the lack of a son, we are reconciled to that.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“აწ ქალისა ჩვენისათვის ქმარი გვინდა, სად მოვნახოთ,
რომე მივსცეთ ტახტი ჩვენი, სახედ ჩვენად გამოვსახოთ,
სამეფოსა ვაპატრონოთ, სახელმწიფო შევანახოთ,
და არ ამოვწყდეთ, მტერთა ჩვენთა ხრმალი ჩვენთვის არ ვამახოთ”.
stanzas.english_translation: "'Now we want a husband for our daughter. Where shall we find him to whom we may give our throne, whom we may form in our image, make him ruler of the kingdom, guardian of the realm, that we be not destroyed, that we may not let our enemies whet their swords for us?'
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 23 ('Counsel Concerning the Marriage of Nestan-Darejan', Stanza 509; Wardrop Stanza 493): Part of the narrative sequence in which king Parsadan and the Queen summon Tariel to a royal council and announce their decision to bring the son of the Shah of Khwarazm to marry Nestan-Darejan and rule India. stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“ვთქვი: “თქვენი ძისა არა სმა გულსა ვით მიეფარების,
მაგრა კმა ჩვენად იმედად, ვინ მზესა დაედარების;
ვისცა სთხოვთ შვილსა სასიძოდ, მას დიდად გაეხარების,
და სხვამცა რა გკადრეთ! თვით იცით, მაგას რა მოეგვარების”.
stanzas.english_translation: "I said: 'How can your heart not feel the want of a son! But she who is like the sun suffices for our hope. Whomsoever you choose as son-in-law, he will rejoice greatly. What more can I say? You yourselves know what will be fitting.'
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 23 ('Counsel Concerning the Marriage of Nestan-Darejan', Stanza 510; Wardrop Stanza 494): Part of the narrative sequence in which king Parsadan and the Queen summon Tariel to a royal council and announce their decision to bring the son of the Shah of Khwarazm to marry Nestan-Darejan and rule India. stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“დავიწყეთ რჩევა საქმისა, გული მიც, თუცა მელია;
ვთქვი: “ჩემგან დაშლა ამისი არ ითქმის, არ საქმნელია!”
მეფემან ბრძანა: “ხვარაზმშა, ხელმწიფე ხვარაზმელია,
და თუ მოგვცემს შვილსა სასიძოდ, მისებრივ არ რომელია”.
stanzas.english_translation: "We began to take counsel on the matter. I tried to keep my heart firm though it was weakened; I said to myself: 'I shall say nothing and can do nothing to hinder this.' The king said: "There is Khvarazmsha, King of the Khvarazmians, if he would give us his child for ours there is none like him.'
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 23 ('Counsel Concerning the Marriage of Nestan-Darejan', Stanza 511; Wardrop Stanza 495): Part of the narrative sequence in which king Parsadan and the Queen summon Tariel to a royal council and announce their decision to bring the son of the Shah of Khwarazm to marry Nestan-Darejan and rule India. Bound by feudal etiquette and fear of exposing his secret love, Tariel is forced to give outward consent while his heart breaks.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“რომე პირველვე დაესკვნა, მათ ესე შეეტყვებოდა;
ერთმანერთსაცა უჭვრეტდეს, სიტყვაცა აგრე სწბებოდა.
ჩემგან დაშლისა კადრება მართ ამბად არ ეგებოდა,
და ოდენ დავმიწდი, დავნაცრდი, გული მი–და-მო კრთებოდა.
stanzas.english_translation: "It was clear that they had settled it beforehand; they glanced at each other, their words also were guarded; it was not for me to venture to say anything to hinder them, only I became as earth and cinders; my heart quivered to and fro.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 23 ('Counsel Concerning the Marriage of Nestan-Darejan', Stanza 512; Wardrop Stanza 496): Part of the narrative sequence in which king Parsadan and the Queen summon Tariel to a royal council and announce their decision to bring the son of the Shah of Khwarazm to marry Nestan-Darejan and rule India. stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“დედოფალმან თქვა: “ხვარაზმშა მეფეა მორჭმით მჯდომელი,
მათსამცა შვილსა სასიძოდ ჩვენთვის სხვა სჯობდა რომელი?”
შეცილებამცა ვით ვჰკადრე, რათგან თვით იყო მნდომელი!
და მოწმობა დავჰრთე, დაესკვნა დღე ჩემი სულთა მხდომელი.
stanzas.english_translation: "The queen said: 'Khvarazmsha is a king reigning with power. Who could be better than his son for our son-in-law!' How could I dare to dispute since they themselves desired it! I added assent. The day of the overthrow of my soul was fixed.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 23 ('Counsel Concerning the Marriage of Nestan-Darejan', Stanza 513; Wardrop Stanza 497): Part of the narrative sequence in which king Parsadan and the Queen summon Tariel to a royal council and announce their decision to bring the son of the Shah of Khwarazm to marry Nestan-Darejan and rule India. Bound by feudal etiquette and fear of exposing his secret love, Tariel is forced to give outward consent while his heart breaks.

stanzas.english_translation: "They sent a man to Khvarazmsha asking for his son. Their message was: 'Our whole realm is without an heir, there is one daughter fit for childbearing, not to be wedded abroad; if thou wilt give us thy son for her, wait not for aught further.'
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 23 ('Counsel Concerning the Marriage of Nestan-Darejan', Stanza 514; Wardrop Stanza 498): Part of the narrative sequence in which king Parsadan and the Queen summon Tariel to a royal council and announce their decision to bring the son of the Shah of Khwarazm to marry Nestan-Darejan and rule India. stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“კაცი მოვიდა; აევსო ჯუბაჩითა და რიდითა,
გაჰხარებოდა ხვარაზმშას სიხარულითა დიდითა;
ებრძანა: “მოგვხვდა ღმრთისაგან, ჩვენ რომე ვინატრიდითა,
და თვით მაგისებრსა შვილსამცა ჩვენ ხელსა რასა ვჰხდიდითა!”
stanzas.english_translation: "The man arrived loaded with mantles and veils. [paragraph continues] Khvarazmsha rejoiced with great joy; he said: From God has befallen us that which we desired; what other child like unto her could we take to our arms?'

დაჰვედრეს თუ: “ნუ აყოვნებთ, მოდით ჩვენად ნაბრძანებად”.

და გულსა სევდა შემეყარა, ვიწევ ჭირთა მოპოვნებად”.
stanzas.english_translation: "Again they sent other men to bring the bridegroom; they entreated him: 'Tarry not, come at our demand.' I was wearied after exercise at ball-playing, and went to my chamber to rest; sadness entered into my heart, I began to endure woes.
